style: retro pixel art weapon pickup sprite for a 1990s PC shooter in the established chunky pixel style of the second and third reference images (style only, never their objects), crisp stepped pixel clusters, dark outlines, limited palette of charcoal gunmetal, muted grey-green enamel, rust and ember with clear value contrast, broad flat areas of colour with hard-edged cel shading, flat even lighting, no gradients, no grain

technical: the whole background is one flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF colour with no checkerboard, no pattern, no gradient and no shadow on it, no hands, no people, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no border
